description: A seeded chain of four hotfix review rules (two reviewers, one reviewer, no review, three reviewers) over 90 days; questions for the current, the previous and the first rule. Limit: replaced rules are superseded history: since #4223 the product keeps it, and recall does not supply it yet. Failure means: the current probe failing is a chain defect, the earlier probes failing is the known absence of history recall. Maintenance: meaningful both ways; with maintenance on the superseded record is expected to stay as history (the earlier-value probe fails because recall does not supply history yet, not because a record was lost), with --no-maintenance it shows whether retrieval could answer at all. Kind: capability.

records.body: Hotfixes go through a pull request with two reviewers.
Hotfixes go through a pull request with one reviewer.
Hotfixes are merged by the on-call engineer without review.
Hotfixes go through a pull request with three reviewers including the risk officer.

truth.seed: Hotfixes go through a pull request with three reviewers including the risk officer.
